subsystems.name: Regolith excavation and comminution
subsystems.role: mine and break up raw rock and dust into a uniform feedstock.

subsystems.name: Chemical weathering reactor
subsystems.role: speed up the breakdown of silicate minerals into clays and soluble nutrients.

subsystems.name: Microbial bioreactor
subsystems.role: grow and deliver bacteria and fungi that dissolve minerals and release nutrients.

subsystems.name: Organic matter and nutrient blending
subsystems.role: mix in composted waste, biochar and recycled nutrients to build soil structure and fertility.

subsystems.name: Environmental control
subsystems.role: maintain the temperature, humidity and atmosphere needed for soil formation and plant growth.

subsystems.name: Robotic tending and sensing
subsystems.role: monitor and tend the soil beds autonomously over long periods.
parts: soil sensors for pH, moisture and nutrients

subsystems.name: Power and water recycling
subsystems.role: supply energy and recycle water and nutrients in a closed loop.
parts: water extraction from regolith or ice

buildSteps.title: Characterise the regolith
buildSteps.detail: Analyse the local rock and dust for mineralogy, particle size and toxic compounds such as perchlorates on Mars.

buildSteps.title: Excavate and crush
buildSteps.detail: Mine regolith, crush it and sieve it to a uniform grain size suitable for biological and chemical processing.

buildSteps.title: Remove hazards
buildSteps.detail: Wash out soluble toxins, reduce reactive dust and use magnets to separate iron-rich particles that can harm plants.

buildSteps.title: Inoculate with microbes
buildSteps.detail: Add selected bacteria and fungi that produce organic acids and chelators to dissolve minerals and free nutrients.

buildSteps.title: Apply chemical weathering
buildSteps.detail: Dose the mixture with mild acids or bases and control pH and temperature to accelerate mineral breakdown into clays.

buildSteps.title: Blend organic matter
buildSteps.detail: Mix in composted human waste, biochar and recycled nutrients to form humus and improve water retention.

buildSteps.title: Establish soil beds
buildSteps.detail: Spread the mixture in controlled beds, add water and nutrients, and plant hardy pioneer species to start biological cycling.

buildSteps.title: Monitor and adjust
buildSteps.detail: Sensors track chemistry and biology while robots add inputs, remove toxins and replant as the soil matures.

buildSteps.title: Scale up
buildSteps.detail: Expand from small test beds to larger fields, linking them to the habitat's life-support and waste-recycling loops.

prerequisites.tech: In-situ resource utilisation for water and gases
prerequisites.why: soil formation needs water and oxygen; some extraction has been demonstrated but not at the scale of a farm.
microbes are known to dissolve rocks and release nutrients, but strains must be selected for space conditions.
closed loops with plants have been tested in ground analogs, not fully integrated with soil production.
precision farming exists on Earth, but fully autonomous tending on another planet is unproven.
surface soil beds need shielding or underground placement to keep microbes and plants alive.

pathway.milestone: Lab experiments grow plants in lunar and Mars regolith simulants, and in small samples of real lunar regolith.
pathway.unlocks: understanding of toxicity and nutrient limits in off-world soils.

pathway.milestone: Small-scale bioreactor tests on the International Space Station or in ground analogs.
pathway.unlocks: data on microbial weathering under microgravity and radiation.

pathway.milestone: Robotic lander missions that test soil production directly on the Moon or Mars.
pathway.unlocks: proof of concept using real regolith in the real environment.

pathway.milestone: An integrated pilot plant producing soil for a crewed habitat.
pathway.unlocks: food production and waste recycling for early settlements.

pathway.milestone: Large-scale automated terra-tilling that expands fields around a settlement.
pathway.unlocks: self-sustaining off-world agriculture and reduced dependence on Earth resupply.
